snippet.title: MAVRIX - Official Full Release Trailer
snippet.description:
MAVRIX by Matt Jones launches into global full release 16th July! Available on Xbox Series S/X, PlayStation 5, Steam, Epic Games and Xbox Game Pass. With this huge update, players can compete head-to-head, enjoy new physics and trick updates, new sponsor challenges and a whole load of new content, including sick shop items! See you on the trails and GOOD LUCK in our first MAVRIX CUP!  

MAVRIX is the Ultimate open world for riders. MTB for all! #mavrix #mavrixgame #mtb
